data.headline: Australia plans a social media ban for children under 16
data.summary: The Australian government announced on Thursday what it described as world-leading legislation that would institute an age limit of 16 years for children to start using social media, and hold platforms responsible for ensuring compliance.  “Social media is doing harm to our kids and I’m calling time on it,” Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said.  The age limit would take effect 12 months after the law is passed, Albanese told reporters.
